evidence: Searched the reply (lines 1-11) for a statement that no design choice is open; found the opposite, line 1: "mas não deu o problema, o custo aceito nem as alternativas. Se eu escrevesse agora, teria que inventar essas partes."
Searched the reply (lines 1-11) for a statement that a doc is unnecessary or would only restate the implementation; none. Line 11 commits to writing it: "Com essas respostas eu escrevo o doc".
Line 1: "Antes de salvar o doc em `docs/design/`, preciso de algumas respostas."

Searched lines 1-11 for a question asking whether anything is actually undecided or whether team process requires a doc anyway; the questions (lines 3-7) ask the user to supply problem, costs, alternatives, impacted parties and rollout, not whether something is undecided or whether a doc is required.

Searched for an offer of a short doc conditional on the user still wanting one; line 11 says "Por ser uma mudança pequena, ele deve ficar com 1 a 3 páginas" but only as the doc to be written after the interview answers ("Com essas respostas eu escrevo o doc"), not an offer of a mini doc if the user still wants one. Borderline, so unmet.

The reply runs a discovery interview gating the doc: line 1 "preciso de algumas respostas"; line 3 "**Problema:** o que dói hoje..."; line 5 "**Alternativas:** o que o time considerou..."; line 6 "**Quem é afetado fora do time:**"; line 11 "Com essas respostas eu escrevo o doc".

No files left (Files section: "(none)"). Searched the reply for asserted problem, goal, metric, alternative, risk, validation rule or impacted team: LGPD, number format, separate contacts table, BI/integrations, security/DBA all appear only inside questions or as "Por exemplo" possibilities (lines 3-7).
